_about: Sophocles in English, translator per title. R. C. Jebb's prose seven plays come from Perseus in the unmerged Thayer/Sophocles PR (slugs sophocles-<play>-jebb) and are cross-referenced, not refetched. Here: Lewis Campbell's verse seven plays (1883), Francis Storr's Theban plays (Loeb, 1912), Gilbert Murray's Oedipus King of Thebes ( US PD per Gutenberg, not PD in life+70 countries), Thomas Sheridan's Philoctetes (1725). Publication years are given only where checked in the file; Murray's per-play years were not, so they are left out.
